full_prompt_en: A square grayscale manga illustration shows a young adult man seated at a desk cluttered with sheets of paper. He occupies the lower left and center, leaning forward in a dark suit jacket over a white shirt and narrow tie. Medium-length layered hair hangs across his brow and partly shadows his eyes. His right hand writes with a pen on a sheet held steady by his left hand; other pages spread across the tabletop and pile up behind him. His mouth curves into a slight controlled smile, but his posture stays intent on the writing. Over his right shoulder, a large skeletal-looking creature emerges from the upper background. Its gaunt face has dark eye sockets and a wide toothy grin. Spiky hair or quill-like projections radiate upward and outward, while thin winglike appendages sweep across the field behind it. Many loose pages appear suspended around the creature, overlapping a textured wall or enormous paper pile. The scene is crowded with diagonal paper edges, thin written-looking strokes, and rough gray shading, yet the man and creature remain clearly distinct through value contrast. The desk runs across the lower edge, the figure is cut at the waist, and the creature fades into the upper margin. A diffuse gray light brightens the central pages, hands, and facial planes; suit and creature's recesses sink into ink black. The drawn finish uses careful fine hatching around hair, cloth, and stacked paper, mixed with darker smudged tones for depth. Marks on the pages suggest writing but are too small and indistinct to read. The mood is cerebral and ominous, turning an ordinary act of writing into an image of hidden supernatural pressure.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形灰阶漫画插画呈现一位年轻成年男子坐在铺满纸张的书桌前。他占据左下与中央，身体前倾，穿深色西装外套、白衬衫与窄领带。中长层叠头发落在额前，部分遮住双眼。右手握笔在一张纸上写字，左手按住纸面；其他纸页铺满桌面，又在身后堆积。嘴角带一丝克制微笑，姿态仍专注于书写。右肩后方，一只大型骨相怪物从上方背景显出。瘦削面孔有深眼窝与露齿大笑；刺状发丝或羽刺向上向外放射，细长翼状附肢横扫身后。许多松散纸页似乎悬在怪物周围，与有纹理的墙或巨大纸堆重叠。斜向纸边、细小似字笔迹和粗糙灰调让场面拥挤，但男子与怪物仍由明暗对比清楚区分。书桌横过下缘，人物在腰部被裁，怪物融入上边。漫射灰光提亮中央纸张、双手和面部平面；西装与怪物凹处沉入墨黑。细密排线刻画头发、衣料和叠纸，较暗的擦抹调子增加深度。纸上的记号像字，却太小太模糊而无法阅读。氛围偏智性而不祥，让平常的书写行为受到隐藏超自然压力笼罩。
style_prompt_en: Dense grayscale manga draftsmanship layers fine hatching, smudged middle tones, and solid black shapes into a crowded yet legible image. Pale rectangular fragments scatter through the field, creating a flickering rhythm against darker organic silhouettes. One grounded lower focal area is balanced by an oversized, spiky upper form; diagonals connect the two. Faces and hands receive precise tonal modeling, while peripheral material loosens into rough grain and repeated strokes. A diffuse light makes paper-white planes glow amid charcoal recesses. Fine lines imply tiny marks without requiring legibility. The close crop, overlapping layers, and sharp shifts of scale create psychological pressure. The finish is hand-drawn, intricate, and ominous, with visual complexity controlled by clear light-dark hierarchy.
style_prompt_zh: 繁密灰阶漫画制图把细排线、擦抹中间调与整块墨黑叠成拥挤却清楚的图像。浅色矩形碎片散布画域，在较暗有机剪影前形成闪烁节奏。下方有实体感的焦点与上方过大的刺状形体平衡，斜线把两者连接。面部与手部获得精确调子造型，周边材料则松为粗颗粒和重复笔迹。漫射光让纸白平面在炭灰凹处之间发亮。细线暗示微小记号，却不要求它们可读。紧密裁切、重叠层次与突变尺度形成心理压力。手绘完成度精密而不祥，视觉复杂性由清楚的明暗层级管束。
theme_en: A young man writes at a paper-covered desk while a grinning winged creature looms behind him
theme_zh: 青年伏在铺满纸的书桌上书写，咧嘴的翼状怪物在后方逼近
name: Death Note
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
